consequence.statement: After the upgrade to 1.18, cert-manager garbage-collects all stale CertificateRequest resources for Certificates that do not explicitly set revisionHistoryLimit. Only the latest revision is kept. The release notes flag this as a potentially breaking change.
consequence.remediation: To keep more CertificateRequest history, set spec.revisionHistoryLimit explicitly on Certificate resources before upgrading.

original.statement: We have changed the default value of `Certificate.Spec.RevisionHistoryLimit` from `nil` to `1`. > 📖 Read Release 1.18 notes for more information.

decision.reason: its a minor finding, good to get review on but acceptable
